Metadata.title: Parts Tracker
Metadata.description: Track PC part prices across the shops PCPartPicker doesn't cover.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.description: Cheapest in-stock prices across your merchants, updated on a schedule.

empty.title: No prices yet
empty.body: Prices appear here after the first scrape run. Merchants and products arrive with the database milestone.

empty.title: Nothing to compare yet
empty.body: The comparison grid and price-gap heatmap arrive with the views milestone.

Builds.title: Builds
Builds.description: Your part lists and their total over time.

empty.title: No builds yet
empty.body: Creating builds needs an account; sign-in arrives with the auth milestone.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Users, merchants, catalog and the review queue.

merchants.title: Merchants
merchants.description: Shops to scrape, how to search them and how to read their pages.

empty.title: No merchants yet
empty.body: Add the first shop to start tracking prices.

fields.name: Name
fields.searchTemplateHint: Must contain '{q}', which is replaced by the search terms.
fields.freeShippingOverHint: Leave empty if there is no threshold.
fields.enabledHint: Scrape this shop on scheduled runs.
fields.visibleToUsersHint: Users can see it and add their own links.
fields.ownOnlyHint: Reject offers sold by marketplace sellers.
fields.needsBrowserHint: Skip plain fetch and render pages with Playwright.
fields.apiEndpointHint: Used instead of HTML search when the shop has a JSON API.
fields.thirdPartyMarkersHint: Comma-separated HTML snippets that prove a marketplace seller.
fields.throttleMsHint: At least 1500; lower values are raised by the scraper.
fields.overridesHint: A JSON object with any other adapter keys.

errors.name: Enter a name.
errors.slug: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
errors.freeShippingOver: Enter 0 or more, or leave empty.
errors.overrides: Must be a valid JSON object.
errors.throttleMs: Enter a whole number, at least 1500.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.body: This removes the merchant and its links. Merchants with price history can't be deleted: disable them instead.

test.title: Test this merchant
test.description: Runs a real check of one product at this merchant and shows what it found. Like a scheduled run, an accepted offer is saved to the price history; uncertain ones go to the review queue. Disabled product links are skipped.
test.noProducts: There are no products to test with.
test.notDispatched: GitHub dispatch isn't configured here. Run this in the repo to start the run:
test.pollStopped: Stopped waiting after 10 minutes. Reopen the page to check again.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Products, their identifiers and archive state.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.limited: Showing the first {count} products. Narrow the search to see others.
catalog.removeDescription: {value} will no longer be used to match offers for this product.

review.title: Review queue
review.description: Uncertain matches waiting for a decision.

users.title: Users
users.description: Approve sign-ups, invite people, and manage roles and access.
users.buildCount: {count, plural, =0 {No builds} one {# build} other {# builds}}

ban.title: Ban {name}
ban.description: They're signed out everywhere and can't sign in until unbanned.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: This removes the account, its sessions and its builds. Shared catalog data and price history stay. It can't be undone.

builds.title: Builds of {name}
builds.description: Read-only list; builds are edited by their owner.

help.open: Anyone can sign up and use the app straight away.
help.approval: Anyone can sign up, but an admin approves each new account. Invited people skip approval.
help.invite_only: Only people with an invite can create an account.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.description: Sends a sign-in link valid for 7 days. Invited accounts skip approval.
invite.open: {count, plural, one {# open invite} other {# open invites}}

errors.notFound: It no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.self: You can't do that to your own account.
errors.userExists: A user with that email already exists.
errors.duplicate: A merchant with that name or slug already exists.
errors.hasHistory: This merchant has price history, which is kept for good. Disable it instead.
errors.alreadyDecided: Someone already decided on this candidate.
errors.dispatchFailed: GitHub didn't accept the run. Check GH_DISPATCH_TOKEN and GH_REPO.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Use GitHub, Google or a one-time link sent to your email.
signIn.sent: Check your inbox: we sent a sign-in link to {email}. It expires in 15 minutes.
signIn.invited: You've been invited. Sign in with the email the invite was sent to.
signIn.noProviders: GitHub and Google sign-in aren't configured on this server.

errors.invite_required: Sign-up is by invitation only. Ask an admin for an invite.

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.body: Your account ({email}) was created. An admin needs to approve it before you can use Parts Tracker; you'll be able to sign in normally once that happens.

magicLink.subject: Your Parts Tracker sign-in link
magicLink.heading: Sign in to Parts Tracker
magicLink.body: Click the button below to sign in. The link works once and expires in 15 minutes.
magicLink.footer: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email.

invite.subject: You're invited to Parts Tracker
invite.heading: You're invited to Parts Tracker
invite.body: {inviter} invited you to track PC part prices with Parts Tracker. Sign in with this email address to accept; the invite expires in 7 days.
invite.footer: If you weren't expecting this, you can ignore this email.
